description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSalaryDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the data access layer for employee salary management features.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeSalaryDao functionalities including save, delete, and retrieval of EmployeeSalary records in the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao, and populates test data from YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeSalary record without direct debit association.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalaryWithEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeSalary record with an associated EmpDirectDebit entity.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee salaries and related direct debit entries.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalariesBulk
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of employee salaries and related entities.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests retrieval of individual EmployeeSalary records with various conditions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple EmployeeSalary records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of EmployeeSalary records matching certain filter criteria.
